newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hokkaido Electric to build hydro power plant.
newsitem.headline: Hokkaido Electric to build hydro power plant.

text.p: Hokkaido Electric Power Co Inc said on Thursday it planned to build a hydroelectric power plant in Kyogokucho, on Japan's northern island of Hokkaido.
Construction is due to start around 2001 and electricity generation in 2006, a Hokkaido Electric spokesman said.
The plant's initial capacity will be 200,000 kilowatts (kw), rising eventually to 600,000 kw, he said.
Hokkaido Electric expects electricity demand in the region it services to grow by an annual average of 2.4 percent over the next 10 years.
